PluginData.FriendlyName: Kontrol Joystick / HOTAS / HOSAS for Space Engineers 2
PluginData.Author: Komandio Labs
PluginData.Tooltip: Hardware flight controls for Space Engineers 2, provided by Kontrol.
PluginData.Description:
Use Kontrol to map joystick, HOTAS, HOSAS, controller, and button-box inputs for Space Engineers 2.
Controls: pitch, roll, yaw; forward/reverse thrust, strafe, and lift; dampeners, lights, parking brakes, power, and leave cockpit; primary fire and reload; camera-mode switch; cruise-control set/increase/decrease; and toolbar slots 1–10.
For setup, controls, and troubleshooting, visit https://www.komandio.com/kontrol.
